search_topic: maximal determinant of 29x29 +1/-1 matrices (Hadamard maximal determinant problem)
brief: a construction script (`construct.py`) that outputs a 29x29 matrix of +1/-1 entries; the score is log10|det| computed exactly, and the loss is log10(Barba upper bound sqrt(2n-1)(n-1)^((n-1)/2)) minus the score. The bound cannot be attained at n=29, so loss 0 is unreachable; lower is better
proxy_note: no verified maximum shipped; loss is measured against Barba's bound sqrt(57)*28^14, which cannot be attained because 2n-1=57 is not a square, so loss 0 is unreachable
